decision_conditions: <p>The following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA within 3 months of the date of this decision:&nbsp;</p><p><b>a</b>. details of all proposed external windows and doors, including large-scale drawings showing each window and its masonry surround (elevations at 1:20 of each window, sections and typical details at 1:5), product details, material, colour and finish;</p><p><b>b</b>. details and samples of all proposed external materials and finishes, including:&nbsp;</p><p><b>i</b>. detailed samples of all brickwork to be used in the development;</p><p><b>ii. </b>details of the external brickwork proposed for the rebuilding of the V profile rear wall (top section), including product details, sample, details of brick bond, mortar mix and pointing style and coping style;</p><p><b>ii</b>. details of all roofing materials;</p><p><b>iii.</b>&nbsp;details of external rainwater goods, vents, flues and any external services or equipment (elevation drawings showing size and location, product details, material, colour and finish); and</p><p><b>iv. </b>details of proposed external balustrading (if applicable).</p><p>The works shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p>Reason: To protect the character and appearance of the conservation area.</p>

<p>Within three months of the date of this decision, the following structures shall be removed in their entirety, and the fabric of the building made good to the satisfaction of&nbsp; the local planning authority:-</p><p>i) the unauthorised rear extension shall be removed in its entirety as required by Enforcement Notice ref: 2021/0015/ENF, and the earlier brickwork, parapets, and&nbsp;butterfly roof shall be reinstated prior to occupation. The reinstatement shall be&nbsp;accurate with regard to form, materials, and method of construction, and shall be&nbsp;maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: To preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.44;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Within 3 months of the date of this permission, detailed specifications, a drainage layout, and a Management &amp; Maintenance Plan for at least one suitable sustainable drainage system serving the retrospective rear extensions shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways, plastic modules or soakaway rings are used, infiltration testing must be carried out to demonstrate that the ground conditions are suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and, where practicable, an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume. The approved sustainable drainage system shall be implemented within 6 months of the date of approval and retained thereafter.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-bdce4078-7fff-8584-cd07-7b220690cddc"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">To prevent surface water flooding and, where possible, enhance biodiversity leading to a net gain.</span></p>

<p>This consent explicitly does not permit the retention of the existing materials as per conditions 1, 2, and 3.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: To preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area.</p>
description: Ground, first and second floor rear extensions (retrospective); proposed amendments to openings at first and second floor; and reinstatement of the original roof form
